title: Building review gates before we build a forecast
key_points: We are wiring guardrails and human review before any public output exists.
A serious research system needs a refusal mode when evidence is not enough.
Local-first and human-in-the-loop are deliberate, not accidental.
limitations: This is product/process commentary, not a market view.

prompt_pack.system_instructions: You are an editorial assistant for Capital Chronicle pre-alpha build-in-public content. Use only facts present in the supplied context. Keep it educational and general. State limitations plainly. Output is for manual human review only.
prompt_pack.user_prompt_template: Using only the supplied context fields, draft a brief process/build update. Context: {{context}}. State limitations plainly.
forbidden_claims: no price targets or position sizing
do not invent numbers, prices, forecasts, or sources
do not imply Capital Chronicle alpha output exists
required_disclaimers: Educational and general; not investment advice.

style_profile.audience: Founders, macro-curious professionals, and serious retail readers who value evidence discipline.
hook_patterns: Open with a process question worth sitting with.
body_patterns: Explain the reasoning, then the limitation.

platform_family_adaptations.x: Tighten to a single clear idea.
platform_family_adaptations.newsletter: Extended room to show the full reasoning.

style_profile.default_limitations_language: Educational and general; not investment advice.

checklist: Manual human review required before any publish.
